text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The day has finally arrived, my friend 
Doto! Now, onward to the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeeeh, already~?! But I haven't even 
made my Make Debut yet~~~."
choice_data_list: Aren't they from the generation above us?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-Whaaaaaat?! You scared me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She seemed to genuinely believe it was 
her own Derby. The three of us went to 
watch it together."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer, Opera O-san. I've heard about 
it before...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I heard the runners in this year's Derby 
are a bunch of man-eating monsters.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! I don't know if they eat people 
or not, but they certainly are called the 
'Golden Generation.'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold! Seiun Sky, aloof and drifting like 
a cloud, and King Halo, claiming the title 
of first-rate all for herself!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"And Hokkaido's 'Do Your Best General,' 
Special Week! Not running today, but 
there's also Grass Wonder, El Condor Pasa, 
and more."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Truly a golden opening act generation! All 
to make me look good when I run next year!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawawa, five of them in total... They 
all look so stronggg~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The ceremony in the paddock came to an 
end, and the race began. And then—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: THANK YOU SOOO MUCH~!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-T-T-Trainer... I just saw... something 
incredible...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So this is the Derby... This is Special 
Week-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The winner was Special Week. With the race 
pace in her favor, a commanding 5-length 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A nail-biting clash at the summit of the 
Golden Generation. Fuchu erupted over the 
breathtaking race, and Meisho Doto, too—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! I-I-If the current me were to run 
in a race like that~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna get lapped at this rate! I 
have to do something, anything~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"What should I start with!? Sprints? 
Swimming? Strength training? Or more 
sprints!?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I said "dash" twice! Is this gonna 
be a penalty game!? Hyawawawa!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Don't panic—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O's theatrical, booming voice 
echoed through the venue.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"What good does it do to be intimidated by 
something like this? Who are you? Just who 
are you?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you the Meisho Doto who resolved to 
walk alongside this T.M. Opera O?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A flight of a thousand stairs begins with 
a single step. If you stumble on that 
first step, there is no future. Wouldn't 
you agree?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Gasp!? T-That's right...! Trainer-san...
choice_data_list:
First, let's do our best in the Make 
Debut.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose you're right. It's not like 
you can just enter the Derby out of 
nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
First, small races. If Trainer-san and 
Opera O-san will lend me a hand...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my absolute best~~~! My Make Debut 
is going to be super! Super~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto gathered her resolve, her 
hands trembling. Watching the Derby seems 
to have given her just the shot in the arm 
she needed.
